g.title: legend
g.text: Control / data is a logical view of responsibilities within the same kernel.
IPC implementations span both columns; storage also serves kernel metadata and stacks.
Arrows: selected uses and collaborations. Dotted: shared infrastructure. Double arrows: work in both directions.
Exact object-symbol dependencies remain in the companion file dependency graph.
